text:
[Council File 19-0131-S3]
City Administrative Officer report relative to a third amendment to Agreement with BlueLA Carsharing Service for completion of the transfer of electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure from the BlueLA EV Carshare Program.
(This item was referred to Energy and Environment Committee, Public Works Committee and Transportation Committee. On August 12, 2026, the Transportation Committee approved this item and on August 12, 2026 the Public Works Committee concurred with the Transportation Committee's action.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Financial Policies Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - AUGUST 23, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - AUGUST 21, 2026)
summary: City Council approves third amendment to BlueLA Carsharing Service agreement to complete transfer of EV charging infrastructure.

outcome.text: Energy and Environment Committee approved item(s) Energy and Environment Committee concurred with the Transportation Committee action of August 12, 2026 to approve this item (Aug 18, 2026); Council adopted item forthwith (Aug 21, 2026); Council action final
